title: Chapter 98 10 Bosses
content:
Chapter 98 10 Bosses

On a hill in the distance.

A giant toad with a body size of more than 50 meters yawned!

The toad had large bumps all over its body, each as big as a millstone.

The slightly opened bloody mouth could swallow a truck.

With his eyes half-closed, he spoke in human language and said to a white wolf king sitting next to him: "Little wolf, have you taken down Wang Shuo's village?"

(All monsters that can speak in human language are referred to as "he" in the following.)

If Wang Shuo were there, he would definitely be scared to death.

Because this white wolf king is also a silver boss.

Moreover, this toad actually knows his name.

"Reply to Master Brunei, not yet."

"Humph, a bunch of trash." Toad Brunei snorted.

The huge air wave directly shook the several toad guards waiting next to them back a few steps.

And the bronze bosses on the other hills all seemed a little uneasy.

The remaining 7 bronze bosses and 2 silver bosses were very puzzled by Brunei's gathering of them here.

But there was nothing they could do, because he was a gold boss.

And he was the commander-in-chief of Changping County responsible for this operation to clean up human players.

"Why didn't I see the bald eagle?"

"Reply, reply to Master Brunei, the bald eagle is dead!"

The one who replied was another silver boss, a tiger with sharp fangs.

After the beast evolved into a silver boss, it can be said that it has left the category of beasts.

They should be called monsters.

They generally have high IQs, and those with lower IQs have long been eliminated by their peers.

After the transverse bones are removed, they can speak.

Even some special populations can transform into human forms in the gold stage.

"Oh, he's quite powerful! Then let him play for a while longer. The happier he is now, the more desperate he will be later."

"Dare to kill my people, you are simply courting death!"

Toad Brunei half-closed his eyes again.

A goat boss, at the signal of the white wolf boss, left the hill where he was and walked towards Wana Village!

...

Outside the Great Locust Domain, a fierce quarrel was taking place in a [chat channel] called "Shenwu Empire".

Lord Qingyang: "Lord Tiexue, is it a bit against the rules for you to do this?"

"What's against the rules? We are all acting within the rules of the game. If we want to play, of course we have to play excitingly."

Lord Qingyang Dongfang Ke, in his bedroom, was furious and his face was ashen. He angrily threw a glass jade cup in his hand to the ground, and it immediately broke into pieces.

The maids beside him were so scared that they dared not move. They had never seen Lord Qingyang get so angry. Even when the enemy was at the gates of the city several times, he was calm and composed.

Dongfang Ke didn't care about Wang Shuo's life or death. What he cared about was his precious daughter Dongfang Ling.

Because she was in Wana Village at the moment.

Many bosses besieged Wana Village. As long as the golden boss took action, this simple city wall would be completely vulnerable.

All this was done by this damn Liu Hong.

The Lord of Qingyang's eyes were blazing with fire, and he gritted his teeth and said, "Liu Hong, don't go too far."

"At worst, we will die together. If you attack Sunset City and Qingyang Mansion at the same time, even if you win, you will definitely be seriously injured. Aren't you afraid that other forces around you will take advantage of your misfortune?"

"That's why I didn't send troops to occupy your territory immediately, but you won't be able to survive for long." The Iron-blooded Lord Liu Hong laughed loudly, looking relaxed and comfortable.

In his mansion, several timid maids were frightened.

Mainly because their lord was really hard to serve.

He would kill people when he was unhappy, and he would kill people when he was happy.

There were no less than a hundred maids and guards executed in the mansion.
